active_account_rules.description: Edit this one file for the current prop account and current independent phase. The scripts never branch on a prop-firm name.

broker_risk_policy.actual_risk_source: broker rounded lot using risk_per_1_lot, broker_min_lot, broker_lot_step
broker_risk_policy.broker_risk_source_policy: 04B per-trade risk_per_1_lot derived from the 00A MT5 broker profile and 00B causal historical profit-currency-to-account-currency conversion

daily_reset_timezone: UTC boundary corresponding to the prop rule; verify DST before each run
failure_definition: hard_fail = breach of any enabled active overall drawdown, daily drawdown, daily-symbol-risk, or floating-loss safety rule; end_of_history_fail = configured target and minimum valid days not achieved before data ends

monte_carlo_gate.gate_meaning: All mandatory integrity and safety gates passed for the current active_account_rules.json contract.
monte_carlo_gate.gate_policy: mandatory controls require exact Script 10 reproduction, zero hard failures, non-negative buffers, and zero projected-reserve violations

monte_carlo_methodology.control_paths: all unique Script 10 start timestamps replayed exactly once
monte_carlo_methodology.diagnostic_paths: historical starts sampled with replacement plus stochastic cost, missed-fill, slippage, gap, asset-decay, and contiguous cluster-window perturbations
monte_carlo_methodology.historical_uncertainty: start-month cluster bootstrap to reduce false precision from overlapping rolling starts
monte_carlo_methodology.limitation: Chronological trade order is retained; this is path stress Monte Carlo, not arbitrary iid trade-order permutation.

risk_formula: overall_buffer = active drawdown breach value minus active floor after open stop risk; guard_multiplier = no_throttle multiplier(overall_buffer); target risk uses HRP weight and calibrated AFML, is clipped by all active overlap, drawdown, reserve, symbol and optional floating-loss caps, then converted to the largest safe broker-executable lot
